note: The bands the Freewing F-16 V3 70 mm EDF plant has to land in, from docs/F16-STAGE1.md, which derives each from Freewing's published figures (the V3 manual FJ211-V02 and the FJ21115P page), Model Aviation's review, the fan's maker's figures, NASA's ducted fan measurements (Weinstein et al., SciTech 2024) and NASA TP-1538's full size F-16 (scripts/f16-derive.js prints the derived figures). Each band is the Kadet's in proportion about its derived figure unless its source says otherwise. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead. Everything in the air is flown with the retracts up, as a jet pilot has them once clear of the field; the take off, the approach glide and the landing with them down, whose drag the table's cd0 carries (the P-51's retracts).

s1_level_50.source: level speed at half stick, the pattern speed the elevator is trimmed neutral at ('the model can also fly the pattern at surprisingly slow speeds', Model Aviation), derived 19.67, within 15 percent Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 22.43, was 19.67; the same 0.850 to 1.150 of it (was 16.72 to 22.62).

s2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 11.98 at CLmax 1.1, the Kadet's -6 and +14 percent (the plant's stall blend rounds the curve off short of CLmax); alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 1.1 / 3.310, of the zero lift line Re-derived 2026-10-11: alphaStall over the wing's own slope, a_w 3.142 (scripts/f16-derive.js), not the wing and tail's 3.31: the stall angle is the wing's and the tail's share lifts on past it, as the Extra's (#935); was 0.3323262839879154. And the band with it: the plant's CLmax is the wing's 1.100 plus the tail's share at that angle, (CLa - a_w) sin a cos a = 0.054, so the formula's speeds go by sqrt(1.100 / 1.154) = 0.9763.

s3_glide.source: L/D at the approach speed, 1.3 Vs, 15.57 m/s, with the gear down as an approach is flown, derived 6.21 (7.09 clean), the Kadet's -11 and +12 percent Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): the gear down glide on the table's cd0, 0.0466 to 0.0487 now the clean 0.0357 is fitted on a full pack, derived 6.09, was 6.21; the same 0.890 to 1.119 of it (was 5.53 to 6.95).

s4_top.source: level speed at full throttle: Freewing's 'maximum flying speed of 165kph', 45.83 m/s, which CD0 is fitted to, within 10 percent; Motion RC's 103 mph, 46.0 m/s, agrees Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): the cd0 FITTED to Freewing's 165 km/h, 45.83 m/s, on a full pack (4.2 V: the manual's 'before flying, we need a fully charged battery'), so 45.83 is the 4.2 V figure and the gates' 4.1 V seat flies derived 44.82, was 45.83; the same 0.900 to 1.100 of it (was 41.25 to 50.41).

s5_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 14.94 at 25.5 m/s (a thrust to weight of 1.13, Freewing's 'strong vertical climbing performance'), the Kadet's -32 and +20 percent Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): at 24.99 m/s, derived 14.51, was 14.94; the same 0.680 to 1.200 of it (was 10.16 to 17.93).

s6_self_level.source: from a 30 deg bank at the pattern speed, every stick centred: the four state lateral model gives 22.9, 19.9 and 17.2 deg after 2, 4 and 6 s, a spiral that halves the bank in 9.4 s through the wing's sweep; the bank at 6 s, the same side, and never steeper than it started Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): the bank at 6 s from the 22.43 m/s pattern speed, derived 15.8, was 17.2; the same 0.465 to 1.512 of it (was 8.0 to 26.0).

s7_roll.source: full right roll stick from level flight at 30 m/s: strip theory's steady p b / 2V of 0.1317 at the F-16's 21.5 deg of aileron is 515 deg/s there, within 25 percent; the full size F-16's 324 deg/s at 250 m/s on its 9.45 m is 0.107, the same airframe's number to a fifth

s8_turn.source: a level 45 deg bank held on the ailerons: the radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown, within the Cub's 15 percent, level

s9_high_alpha.source: full up held from 20 m/s at 60 percent, the wings held level on the ailerons as the pilot of a high alpha pass does: the pitching moment through the stall's model trims at 31.5 deg of alpha (f16:derive, full up mush), Freewing's 'the aircraft can also maintain a high alpha of 30 degrees to demonstrate its superior low speed stability'; alpha over the last 2 s in the band, the ailerons still holding the wings within 15 deg (no wing drop they cannot catch), no yaw that is a spin. Hands off it is a slow spiral, which the gate prints and does not hold The yaw limit is re-derived 2026-10-11 from a spin's definition, autorotation: with the wings inside the bank limit the aircraft only turns, at g tan(bank) / V, so the limit is the turn that bank allows at the mush's measured speed (tests/lib/wingpilot.js turnYawLimitDeg, docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md), where it was 20 deg/s with no source. Re-measured 2026-10-12, band unchanged, the measured quantity changed: the bank is the span's tilt off the horizon, asin(sin phi cos theta), the body y axis's world z, and the pilot holds that. It is never larger than the Euler bank and equals it at level pitch; the Euler bank is singular at a vertical nose (phi dot = p + (q sin phi + r cos phi) tan theta, Etkin and Reid's kinematic equations), and the entry then, full up from 25.7 m/s, zoomed to 78 to 80 deg of pitch (measured), where the fan's precession yaw of 5 to 7 deg/s read as 31 to 37 deg of Euler bank with the wings within 9 of level. With the Euler sensing pilot the tilt is 14.5, with the tilt sensing pilot 8.8, both under 15. Entry re-derived 2026-10-12: from level at the normal approach speed, 1.3 times the middle of S2's band, as FAA-H-8083-3C ch. 5 sets up a stall ("Airspeed in excess of the normal approach speed should not be carried into a stall entry since it could result in an abnormally nose-high attitude"), the stick brought up by the person's hand; it was full up from level at 60 percent, 25.7 m/s, which overshot to 44 deg of alpha in 0.24 s.

s10_phugoid.source: the phugoid root of the four state longitudinal model trimmed at the 19.67 m/s pattern speed, derived 9.84, the Kadet's -18 and +17 percent Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): trimmed at the 22.43 m/s pattern speed, derived 11.27, was 9.84; the same 0.828 to 1.171 of it (was 8.15 to 11.52).

fromStop.source: full stick from a stopped fan: the ESC's 300 ms Normal startup ramp and the fan's critically damped speed at tau 0.08 s reach the speed of 90 percent of the static thrust at 0.562 s (f16:derive), within 10 percent; a prop reaches its in the step the stick moves Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): the stopped fan meeting an unloaded pack, its command over v_meas at last step's current (f16-derive.js spool), derived 0.505, was 0.562; the same 0.900 to 1.100 of it (was 0.506 to 0.618).

fromSpin.source: from a fan already turning at 30 percent to full: 0.343 s to 90 percent of the static thrust, within 10 percent Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): the fan at 30 percent on its own pack, run to full on a pack its current has not yet sagged, derived 0.267, was 0.343; the same 0.901 to 1.099 of it (was 0.309 to 0.377).

down.source: full to a closed stick: the thrust is under 10 percent 0.189 s later, within 10 percent Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): from the seat's full speed, derived 0.188, was 0.189; the same 0.899 to 1.101 of it (was 0.17 to 0.208).

s12_thrust_vs_speed.source: full throttle at a held airspeed: the fan's thrust over its static 23.54 N against n^2 (1 - u / (76.87 n)), n the fan's speed over its full 41,703 rpm (the pack's sag slows it a little), NASA's C_T linear in the advance ratio to zero at J = 1.603 on the 69 mm rotor; at full speed 0.74 at 20 m/s and 0.48 at 40, within 3 percent of the static thrust

s13_energy.source: level at 75 percent, then the throttle closed and the height held: from the 33.86 m/s cruise to the 15.57 m/s approach speed takes 11.0 s and 261 m (f16:derive, energy), within 20 percent: a clean jet does not slow down, so an approach is planned from far out Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): from the 35.23 m/s cruise at 75 percent (was 33.86), 11.0 s, the distance derived 265.5, was 260.6; the same 0.798 to 1.201 of it (was 208 to 313).

s14_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, level, the CG 0.140 m up, 14.9 percent of the weight on the nose wheel (f16:derive, rest), within half a degree, 3 mm and 4 percent

s15_takeoff.source: full throttle on grass from a stopped fan, the elevator eased up to full past 1.2 Vs: the fan's thrust through the CG, 0.140 m over the mains' contact, holds the nose on its wheel until full up stabilator lifts it at 16.9 m/s after 17.3 m (f16:derive, rotation), so it lifts off between 1.3 and 1.6 Vs, from 0.9 of the roll to rotation to 1.1 of the roll to 1.6 Vs, 23.3 m: Freewing's 'short takeoff distance' at full power Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas, the fan at its duty, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat, and the clean cd0 0.0357 fitted on a full pack): full up lifts it at 17.03 m/s after 17.94 m, the roll to 1.6 Vs 23.68 m (f16:derive), so 0.9 of the one to 1.1 of the other, 16.1 to 26.0 (was 15.6 to 25.7 from 17.3 and 23.32).

s15b_scale_takeoff.source: the same at 55 percent, Model Aviation's 'takeoff throttle settings of 50% to 60% and gradual application of up-elevator will result in scalelike, shallow angle-of-attack departures': the fan's thrust with its speed squared and falling with the airspeed makes the roll to 1.2 Vs 72.2 m and to 1.6 Vs 308 m, the gear's drag in both (f16:derive), a long jet's roll; it lifts off between the two Flown since 2026-10-11 with the pilot's hand holding the 8 deg it rotates to (wingpilot.js f16TakeoffSticks, FAA-H-8083-3C ch. 6), as f16:derive's lift off takes it: the proportional hold alone drooped to 5.6 deg once the ground effect's nose down moment (plant_wing.c GROUND EFFECT) wanted 3.9 deg more up stabilator, and lifted off at 19.20 m/s. Derived, at the held 8 deg: 17.54 m/s in free air, 16.72 with the ground effect (sigma 0.354 at the wing's 0.140 m); the band, 1.2 to 1.6 Vs, holds it unchanged. Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas, the fan at its duty, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): at 55 percent the roll to 1.2 Vs is 52.4 m and to 1.6 Vs 145.6 m (f16:derive), was 72.2 and 308.4.

s16_landing.source: an approach from 12 m at 1.3 Vs, 15.57 m/s, on the elevator and a 3.5 deg path on the throttle (at idle its glide is 8 deg steep), the throttle closed over the threshold at 1.2 m as Model Aviation's pilot does and the nose raised to 9 deg: a jet lands fast because its tail limits the flare, the nozzle's skid striking at 11.4 deg of pitch on the mains, so it touches no slower than 14.82 m/s, 1.24 Vs, and at 9 deg at 16.50 (f16:derive, touchdown), within 5 percent over that; it comes to rest on its three wheels at S14's attitude, no hull or skid, after a roll out of about 94 m with the gear's drag on the grass (f16:derive)

s17_unmoved.source: the five inch's canonical replay hash and every other aircraft's recorded flight hash in Node, from main's module at 4ea84e3, before the F-16 existed, and the P-51's two from main's at 1cce6bb, after #127 sharpened its stall on purpose (its own p51:gates S18 records the same two), before the F-16 joined it Re-pinned for the prop's slipstream and its gyroscope on every prop (docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md): the recordings flown under power moved; the five inch's is as it was. Re-pinned 2026-10-12 (w36-p51-clmax): the P-51's two recorded flights (p51 was 7219c30ebb48a05c, p51-air 4646a1ba51f005db) moved with its stall taken from measured sections, stall_re and stall_round on its own table (docs/P51-STAGE1.md); this aircraft's own recordings are unmoved.

s18_cross_host.source: the F-16's recorded take off and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome

s20_stopped.source: the throttle closed on the strip: an electric ESC stops the fan (it has no idle), so nothing turns, nothing pushes, and the aircraft stands

s21_hands_off_glide.source: level at 75 percent, then the throttle closed and every stick let go, in Manual: the fan spools down to nothing and the neutral elevator's pitching moment trims the glide at 7.1 deg of alpha, 19.57 m/s sinking 2.68 m/s (f16:derive, hands off glide). The mean from 8 s, after the phugoid's first cycle; the sink within 15 percent, the speed S1's band, and it never reaches the stall's alpha Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): the neutral elevator trims the glide at 5.4 deg of alpha (cm_0 0.0361, re-derived at the pattern speed), 22.29 m/s; the speed band is S1's, now 19.07 to 25.79; the sink derived 3.458, was 2.684; the same 0.849 to 1.151 of it (was 2.28 to 3.09). The window re-derived the same day: the glide is the trimmed one only once the chop's phugoid has died, and the derivation's phugoid at the pattern speed, 11.27 s at a damping of 0.164, decays by e in 1 / (zeta omega) = 10.9 s, so three of those, 33 s, before the mean is taken: 40 to 60 s (was 8 to 20 s, under one period, which read the transient: 4.06 m/s there against 3.49 settled at 22.32 m/s, the derivation's 3.458 at 22.29).

s22_chop.source: throttle closed from level flight at the pattern speed the elevator is trimmed neutral at, pitch stick neutral: a glide, not a tumble
